recognize_zh: 中央巨噬細胞細胞質裡有十多個大小一致的小橢圓形酵母菌，周圍有透亮暈圈、內含偏心新月形染色質；右側還有兩顆游離在外的菌體，典型 Histoplasma capsulatum。
features: Macrophage with central round nucleus and foamy cytoplasm containing numerous small intracellular yeasts
Yeasts uniform, oval, about 2-4 um, each with a clear halo and eccentric crescentic chromatin
Pair of extracellular yeasts at right of the macrophage
Additional vacuolated macrophages and a mitotic figure/degenerating cell at bottom
describe_en: Aspirate smear shows several vacuolated macrophages; the central macrophage contains numerous uniform, small oval yeast forms with clear halos and eccentric crescent-shaped chromatin. Two similar organisms are present extracellularly to the right. No hyphae are seen. Findings are consistent with disseminated histoplasmosis (Histoplasma capsulatum); correlation with GMS stain, antigen testing and culture is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes show a nucleus plus a bar-shaped kinetoplast and lack a clear halo.
Talaromyces yeasts are elongated, sausage-shaped forms dividing by a central septum (fission) rather than budding.
Cryptococcus is larger (4-10 um), variably sized, with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule and narrow-based budding.
Overlying platelets are irregular granular fragments without a refractile wall, halo or crescentic nucleus.
